a: The ID of the instance or a fully qualified identifier for the instance.
Represents the type of Data Fusion instance. Each type is configured with the default settings for processing and memory. - BASIC: Basic Data Fusion instance.
User-managed service account to set on Dataproc when Cloud Data Fusion creates Dataproc to run data processing pipelines.
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
An optional description of the instance.
Option to enable granular role-based access control.

The resource labels for instance to use to annotate any related underlying resources, such as Compute Engine VMs. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Map of additional options used to configure the behavior of Data Fusion instance.
Current patch revision of the Data Fusion.
Specifies whether the Data Fusion instance should be private. If set to true, all Data Fusion nodes will have private IP addresses and will not be able to access the public internet.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The region of the Data Fusion instance.
A map of resource manager tags. Resource manager tag keys and values have the same definition as resource manager tags.
Current version of the Data Fusion.
Name of the zone in which the Data Fusion instance will be created. Only DEVELOPER instances use this field.
The type of an accelator for a CDF instance. Possible values: ["CDC", "HEALTHCARE", "CCAI_INSIGHTS"]
The type of an accelator for a CDF instance. Possible values: ["ENABLED", "DISABLED"]
The name of the key which is used to encrypt/decrypt customer data. For key in Cloud KMS, the key should be in the format of projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*.
The resource name of the Pub/Sub topic. Format: projects/{projectId}/topics/{topic_id}
An RRULE with format RFC-5545 for how this window reccurs. They go on for the span of time between the start and end time. The only supported FREQ value is "WEEKLY".
The end time of the time window provided in RFC 3339 format.
The start time of the time window provided in RFC 3339 format.

Optional. Type of connection for establishing private IP connectivity between the Data Fusion customer project VPC and the corresponding tenant project from a predefined list of available connection modes.
The IP range in CIDR notation to use for the managed Data Fusion instance nodes. This range must not overlap with any other ranges used in the Data Fusion instance network.
Name of the network in the project with which the tenant project will be peered for executing pipelines.
Optional. The reference to the network attachment used to establish private connectivity. It will be of the form projects/{project-id}/regions/{region}/networkAttachments/{network-attachment-id}.
Optional. Input only. The CIDR block to which the CDF instance can't route traffic to in the consumer project VPC. The size of this block should be at least /25.
